test_suite_name: V3 Player Ship Destruction and Terra Enforcement Acceptance
description: Ordinary players destroy a no-escape-pod ship and receive a universal escape pod; cargo/equipment loss is atomic while unrelated personal, bank, planet, and corporate assets survive. Terra sanction uses the same destruction policy.

tests.name: Bootstrap disposable SysOp fixture session
Setup ordinary combat attacker
Setup ordinary combat victim
Setup ordinary Terra-sanction victim
Select a disposable combat sector outside FedSpace

data.sql: SELECT MIN(s.sector_id) FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id>10 AND COALESCE(s.navhaz,0)=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sector_hazards h WHERE h.sector_id=s.sector_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sector_assets a WHERE a.sector_id=s.sector_id AND a.quantity>0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM planets p JOIN citadels c ON c.planet_id=p.planet_id WHERE p.sector_id=s.sector_id AND c.level>=3 AND (c.qCannonSector>0 OR c.militaryReactionLevel>0));

tests.name: Create corporation and membership fixtures for preserved corporate assets

data.sql: WITH c AS (INSERT INTO corporations(name,owner_id,tag) VALUES ('V3 Destruction QA',(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim'),'DQA1') RETURNING corporation_id), m AS (INSERT INTO corp_members(corporation_id,player_id,role) SELECT c.corporation_id,p.player_id,CASE WHEN p.name='destruction_victim' THEN 'Leader' ELSE 'Officer' END FROM c CROSS JOIN players p WHERE p.name IN ('destruction_victim','terra_sanction_victim') RETURNING corporation_id) INSERT INTO corp_accounts(corp_id,balance) SELECT corporation_id,70000 FROM c;

tests.name: Create a direct disposable route from FedSpace to the combat sector

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps(from_sector,to_sector) VALUES (1,@{destruction_battle_sector}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Prepare combat victim's ship with no escape-pod equipment, cargo, and installed equipment

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE enabled=TRUE AND has_escape_pod=FALSE AND name<>'Escape Pod' ORDER BY shiptypes_id LIMIT 1),hull=10,shields=0,fighters=0,installed_shields=25,has_transwarp=TRUE,photons=3,ore=4,destroyed=FALSE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim');

tests.name: Insert authoritative cargo row on the victim ship

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) VALUES ((SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim'),'ORE',4);

tests.name: Give combat victim a surviving non-active ship

data.sql: WITH extra AS (INSERT INTO ships(name,type_id,sector_id,holds,fighters,shields,hull,destroyed) SELECT 'Destruction reserve hull '||p.name,(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE enabled=TRUE AND name<>'Escape Pod' ORDER BY shiptypes_id LIMIT 1),1,10,7,3,90,FALSE FROM players p WHERE p.name IN ('destruction_victim','terra_sanction_victim') RETURNING ship_id,name), role AS (SELECT role_id FROM ship_roles WHERE role='owner' ORDER BY role_id LIMIT 1) INSERT INTO ship_ownership(ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) SELECT extra.ship_id,p.player_id,role.role_id,FALSE FROM extra CROSS JOIN role JOIN players p ON extra.name='Destruction reserve hull '||p.name;

tests.name: Create player bank accounts and preserve exact balances

data.sql: INSERT INTO bank_accounts(owner_type,owner_id,currency,balance,is_active) SELECT 'player',player_id,'CRD',50000,TRUE FROM players WHERE name IN ('destruction_victim','terra_sanction_victim') ON CONFLICT (owner_type,owner_id,currency) DO UPDATE SET balance=EXCLUDED.balance,is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Create independently owned planets that destruction must preserve

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,created_by,ore_on_hand,organics_on_hand,equipment_on_hand,colonists_unassigned) SELECT @{destruction_battle_sector},'Destruction survivor '||p.name,p.player_id,'player','M',321,p.player_id,123,234,345,321 FROM players p WHERE p.name IN ('destruction_victim','terra_sanction_victim');

tests.name: Seed corporation-owned defense assets for both members

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting) SELECT 1,p.player_id,c.corporation_id,2,77,0 FROM players p CROSS JOIN corporations c WHERE p.name IN ('destruction_victim','terra_sanction_victim') AND c.tag='DQA1';

tests.name: Verify the destroyed target ship type does not grant an escape pod

data.sql: SELECT (st.name<>'Escape Pod' AND st.has_escape_pod=FALSE)::int FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id WHERE p.name='destruction_victim';

tests.name: Refresh attacker session after fixture positioning
Refresh combat victim session after fixture positioning
Refresh Terra victim session in sector one
Ordinary attacker warps to the combat sector
Ordinary victim warps to the combat sector
Ordinary attacker destroys the other player's ship
Verify exact ship loss, universal pod, cargo/equipment loss, surviving hull, and preserved assets

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT destroyed AND hull=0 AND fighters=0 AND shields=0 AND installed_shields=0 AND has_transwarp=FALSE AND photons=0 AND ore=0 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{destruction_victim_active_ship_id})::int,(SELECT st.name='Escape Pod' AND NOT pod.destroyed AND pod.sector_id=1 FROM players p JOIN ships pod ON pod.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=pod.type_id WHERE p.name='destruction_victim')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=@{destruction_victim_active_ship_id})::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM ship_ownership WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND is_primary=TRUE)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM ship_ownership so JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=so.ship_id WHERE so.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND so.is_primary=FALSE AND s.name='Destruction reserve hull destruction_victim' AND NOT s.destroyed)::int,(SELECT balance=50000 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND currency='CRD')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(population)=321 AND MIN(ore_on_hand)=123 FROM planets WHERE owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND name='Destruction survivor destruction_victim')::int,(SELECT balance=70000 FROM corp_accounts ca JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=ca.corp_id WHERE c.tag='DQA1')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=2 AND MIN(quantity)=77 FROM sector_assets a JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=a.corporation_id WHERE c.tag='DQA1')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='ship.destroyed' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim'))::int;

tests.name: Retry combat against already destroyed historical hull
Retried combat created no second pod or destruction event

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='ship.destroyed' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim'))::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM ship_ownership so JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=so.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id WHERE so.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND so.is_primary=TRUE AND st.name='Escape Pod')::int;

tests.name: Terra victim attacks Terra and receives the shared destruction consequence
Verify Terra enforcement preserves bank, planet, corporation, secondary hull, and pod state

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT st.name='Escape Pod' AND NOT pod.destroyed FROM players p JOIN ships pod ON pod.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=pod.type_id WHERE p.name='terra_sanction_victim')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='ship.destroyed' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='terra_sanction_victim'))::int,(SELECT balance=50000 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='terra_sanction_victim') AND currency='CRD')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM planets WHERE owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='terra_sanction_victim') AND population=321 AND ore_on_hand=123)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM ship_ownership so JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=so.ship_id WHERE so.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='terra_sanction_victim') AND so.is_primary=FALSE AND s.name='Destruction reserve hull terra_sanction_victim' AND NOT s.destroyed)::int,(SELECT balance=70000 FROM corp_accounts ca JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=ca.corp_id WHERE c.tag='DQA1' AND ca.balance=70000)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=2 AND MIN(quantity)=77 FROM sector_assets a JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=a.corporation_id WHERE c.tag='DQA1')::int;
